evals.prompt: /setup. This is my first time using this Studio. I have not chosen any preferences yet.
evals.expected_output: Begin a short interview with two or three questions, including scope and prompt-only versus agent assistance. Offer defaults and skipping without saving or starting production.
assertions: The first response asks two or three questions rather than the whole questionnaire.
The user can choose prompt-only mode and workspace-wide or production-specific scope.
No preferences, production files, credentials or media are created before confirmation.

evals.prompt: Remember prompt-only mode, faster results, concise English prompts for this workspace. Save those preferences, but keep my existing detailed review preference.
evals.expected_output: Save only the explicitly authorized preferences, retain strict review and unrelated settings, read them back and explain fast/prompt-only safety boundaries. No repeat interview, generation or global edits.
assertions: Persisted preferences contain prompt_only, fast, concise and English while preserving review_mode strict and unrelated custom preferences.
A fresh read returns the saved preferences and no production directory or global configuration was changed.
Fast priority does not change model policy, grant generation permission or bypass native drafts.
